commands.notes: Widget and Live Activity controls delegate transport state to the canonical app runtime.
Skip payload preserves the current PlaybackPosition-derived media time when available so the app resolves chapter and transcript context.

Chapter jumps delegate the selected chapter id plus any known media time and transcript segment anchor; the app performs the seek.

The widget interject button opens the app with a command URL and immediately delegates beginInterjection to the canonical runtime; the widget never starts local recording. The delegated payload should include PlaybackPosition mediaTimeMs, durationMs when known, chapterId, and transcriptSegmentId when available.
Finish only completes recording already owned by the app runtime after the delegated beginInterjection path.

backendRequests.title: Publish PlaybackPosition-derived media fields to compact widget and Live Activity snapshots
backendRequests.details: Compact snapshots should expose real mediaTimeMs, durationMs, sourceProgressPercent/currentPlaybackProgressPercent, chapterTitle, and transcriptSegmentId when media or transcript timing is available, without requiring widget-owned playback.

backendRequests.title: Route widget interject URLs to immediate beginInterjection delegation
backendRequests.details: The app-open URL for the widget/Live Activity interject action should foreground the app and dispatch SessionEngine.beginInterjection with the current media/chapter/transcript anchors, not start recording inside the extension.

notes: Live Activity title, chapterTitle, and progress must be derived from PlaybackPosition real media time when available, falling back to existing percent fields only when duration or transcript timing is unknown.
Widget and Live Activity surfaces do not own playback, recording, persistence, transcription, or AI work.
Interjection anchor payloads should preserve mediaTimeMs, durationMs, chapterId, and transcriptSegmentId where available so the app can attach the recording to the correct source moment.
